output.public_justification: Certification is supportable on the present record only on a disclosure-based theory, not on a theory that the subgroup issue is resolved. Admissible evidence shows the current release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.2 percentage points and had no severity-one incidents in launch rehearsal. Admissible policy and public guidance also support proceeding when current evaluation results are reflected in release documentation and material limitations for named use cases are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
